transcript: Speaker A (Waiter): पूरे रेस्टोरेंट के सामने उसने मुझे गंवार बोल दिया क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश नहीं आती थी। मैंने बस एक गलत आर्डर ही तो लाया था, पर उसने मेरी इज्जत का कचरा कर दिया। [He called me illiterate in front of the whole restaurant because I didn't know English. I had only brought one wrong order, but he ruined my respect.] Speaker B (Customer): What is this? I specifically asked for a medium rare steak with sautéed veggies. इंग्लिश समझ नहीं आती तो शहर क्यों चले आते हो? गांव के गंवार ही रहोगे तुम लोग। [If you don't understand English, why do you come to the city? You people will always remain village bumpkins.] Speaker C (Presenter): और यह सिर्फ रेस्टोरेंट के लिए नहीं है, चाहे आप ऑफिस में हों, बड़े रेस्टोरेंट में हों या बच्चों के स्कूल में। [And this is not just for restaurants, whether you are in an office, a big restaurant, or a children's school.] Speaker D (Voiceover): Install now पर क्लिक करो और अभी इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]

summary: An animated story of a waiter who is publicly humiliated by a customer for not knowing English. He decides to learn English using the 'English Seekho' app, which features bite-sized lessons and an AI coach named Disha. He successfully improves his English, earns a promotion, and regains his confidence, urging viewers to download the app.
